formulas.name: BagReplacementContact
formulas.expression: IF( {!varControllingValue} = 'Bag Replacement', OR( ISBLANK({!Get_Case_Records.ContactId} ), ISBLANK( {!Get_Case_Records.Contact_Phone__c} ), ISBLANK( {!Get_Case_Records.Street__c} ), ISBLANK( {!Get_Case_Records.Suburb__c} ), ISBLANK( {!Get_Case_Records.Post_Code__c} ), ISBLANK( {!Get_Case_Records.State__c} ), ISPICKVAL( {!Get_Case_Records.Country__c}, '' ) ),false )

formulas.name: Credit_card_Token_valid
formulas.expression: NOT(CONTAINS({!Credit_card_Token}, 'XXX')) && AND( REGEX({!Credit_card_Token}, "^[0-9][A-Z0-9]+$") , REGEX({!Credit_card_Token}, ".*[A-Z].*"), REGEX({!Credit_card_Token}, ".*[0-9].*") ) && LEN({!Credit_card_Token}) < 17 && LEN({!Credit_card_Token}) > 9

formulas.name: CreditCardExpired
formulas.expression: IF( OR( VALUE({!Card_Expiry_Year}) < YEAR(TODAY()), AND( VALUE({!Card_Expiry_Year}) = YEAR(TODAY()), CASE( {!Card_Expiry_Month}, "01 (Jan)", 1, "02 (Feb)", 2, "03 (Mar)", 3, "04 (Apr)", 4, "05 (May)", 5, "06 (Jun)", 6, "07 (Jul)", 7, "08 (Aug)", 8, "09 (Sep)", 9, "10 (Oct)", 10, "11 (Nov)", 11, "12 (Dec)", 12, NULL ) < MONTH(TODAY()) ) ), TRUE, FALSE )

formulas.name: Flight_Ticket_Number_Valid
formulas.expression: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!Flight_Ticket_Number})), LEN({!Flight_Ticket_Number}) = 13, REGEX({!Flight_Ticket_Number}, "^[0-9]{13}$") ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!Flight_Ticket_Number_TREFT})), LEN({!Flight_Ticket_Number_TREFT}) = 13, REGEX({!Flight_Ticket_Number_TREFT}, "^[0-9]{13}$") ) )

formulas.description: Date the Date before One year
formulas.name: OneYearAgo
Process_Status
formulas.expression: IF( OR( {!varControllingValue} = "Qantas Points", {!varControllingValue} = "Payment (EFT)", {!varControllingValue} = "Payment (Credit Card)", {!varControllingValue} = "Travel vouchers", {!varControllingValue} = "Lounge Passes", {!varControllingValue} = "Ticket Refund EFT", {!varControllingValue} = "Cover Refund" ), "Pending Approval", IF( OR( {!varControllingValue} = "No Goodwill", {!varControllingValue} = "First Lounge Pass", {!varControllingValue} = "Space available upgrade", {!varControllingValue} = "Firm space upgrade" ), "Finalised", IF( OR( {!varControllingValue} = "Bag Repair", {!varControllingValue} = "Bag Replacement" ), "Submitted for Finalisation", "" ) ) )
